processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: The alloyed steels were produced by casting using a 100 kW vacuum induction furnace, resulting in 0.5 kg ingots.
The ingots were hot-rolled at 1150 °C, obtaining 5 mm flat-products.
Hot-rolling at 1150 °C was followed by water quenching; this hot-rolled state is used as the reference (as-received) condition in all hardness tables.

measurement_conditions.other_conditions: Hot-rolled (as-received) condition at 1150 °C + water quenching, before any tempering heat treatment

characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: A 5 kg load was applied for all the indentations; 5 indentations per sample were made.
characterization_methods.purpose: macro-hardness measurement of the processing conditions (hot-rolled and tempered)

characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Through-thickness embedding, grinding and polishing performed separately for hot-rolled and heat-treated samples.
characterization_methods.purpose: analyse all the alloys at the different processing conditions (hot-rolling and tempering)

computational_details.simulation_method: CALPHAD thermodynamic equilibrium calculation (phase amount [mol] vs temperature)
computational_details.boundary_and_initial_conditions: Composition 9Al-30Mn-1C (wt%); temperature range 0–1300 °C; phases considered: FCC_A1, BCC_2SL, LIQUID, KAPPA_E21, BCC_A2. FCC_A1 rises to a 1.00 mol plateau (~800–1050 °C) then declines; BCC_A2 vanishes near 500 °C; KAPPA_E21 (~0.20 mol) falls to zero near 520 °C.
computational_details.validation_against_experiment: Used qualitatively to explain the thermodynamic gradient in austenite (FCC_A1) stability between hot-rolling (1150 °C) and tempering temperatures for this composition.

unmapped_findings: Ambiguity/inconsistency in Table 5: the raw table row is printed as '9Al-30Mn1C' (hot-rolled 324 HV, 800 °C tempered 352 HV) whereas the figure description reads the same row as '12Al-30Mn1C'; this hot-rolled value (324 HV) conflicts with the 216 HV reported for 9Al-30Mn-1C in Table 8, so the hot-rolled hardness of the 9Al-30Mn-1C composition is not fully consistent across the two tables.
Table 8 shows the hot-rolled hardness of the 9Al-xMn-1C series decreases monotonically with increasing Mn: 9Al-10Mn-1C = 273 HV, 9Al-20Mn-1C = 233 HV, 9Al-30Mn-1C = 216 HV.
